featured_reviews.review_text:
As I bring this chapter of my fitness journey to a close, I want to express my deepest gratitude for everything I’ve experienced over the past year.

First and foremost, thank you to my sister Vidya — she was the one who introduced me to this gym and encouraged me to take the first step. I’ll always be grateful to her for setting me on this path.

When I started my journey with Womentain, it wasn’t easy. I struggled with posture, steps, aasan, and stamina. Every day I cried at home, but I never gave up.
Slowly, with patience, persistence, and the incredible support of each one of you, I pushed through those challenges — and it changed my life.

There were times we fought for space, equipment, and even the mirror, but honestly, I loved every bit of it — especially our fun gossip sessions that made the tough days easier and the journey more joyful.

Today, I stand 15 kg lighter —  but more importantly, I feel stronger, healthier, and more confident.

A heartfelt thank you to my
CrossFit trainer – Supriya,
Yoga trainer – Jabin,
Zumba trainer – Swamini,
Aerobics trainer – Jaya,
Receptionist – Anita.
Your guidance, energy, and motivation made every session count, and your warm support made the gym feel like home.

Special thanks to Anita Ma’am, our Principal — from you, I learned the importance of posture and that “age is just a number.” You are a true inspiration.

As they say, *“कहीं पहुँचने के लिए कहीं से निकलना ज़रूरी होता है।”*
This may be the end of this chapter, but it’s just the beginning of a new one. The lessons, memories, and strength I’ve gained here will always stay with me.

With heartfelt gratitude, *Neha Kini*

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Wandrekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The trend today is “One Stop Solutions”. Looking at today’s fast life pace, people are keen on having multiple facilities in one spot. This is where “EARTH FITNESS” shines (@earthfitness_gym). Earth Fitness is a multi-storied gym that houses all facilities for your physical training. I would say it’s one of a kind right from Palghar to Mumbai. It is manned by a majority Maharashtrian Staff who are kind, courteous & quite knowledgeable in their field. The Gym is owned by Mr. Ritesh Naik. Ritesh is an accomplished fitness expert who has won numerous titles in the field of “Body Building”. Some of them are “Shree” Titles at Vasai, Palghar, Juichandra, West Thane, Safala, Mumbai Mayor Cup, Mr. India Silver Medal & many more. Ritesh has dedicated his life in pursuit of fitness with great difficulties & has now made a gym with these facilities easily available for us.

Facilities:
The gym is sprawled across three floors, the 3rd floor consists of a Weight Lab that has numerous imported weight training equipment’s. The equipment’s are quite modern in nature & are designed to safely target a specific muscle in the body.
The 4th floor is a cross fitness & cardio lab. It’s equipped with multiple treadmills, rowing machines, steppers, spinning cycles, etc. This space is also used for yoga, kick boxing, Zumba & boot camp cross fitness.
The 5th floor is being developed for post work out care, that will include, massages, steam rooms, ice baths, nutrition bar & many more (kept under the wraps for now)

Most importantly this Gym has a janitorial department who continuously keep the gym, locker rooms, changing rooms & washrooms clean. You will never find a speck of dust, or a drop of sweat or a smudge on the mirror. The place is always clean. Oh, did I mention that they have a KILLER YAMAHA SOUND SYSTEM…………

Training:
Earth Fitness houses qualified trainers, these trainers are assigned based on individual body type & individual goals. The gym owns an advanced BMI machine that provides a detail muscle to fat ratio report along with body balance & projected goals. Members opting for Personal Trainers (P.T.) are requested to send in their blood work along with a detailed schedule. This helps the Gym assign a trainer, training program & nutrition program.

Trainers
Sudhir Mankar (@sudhirmankar_official) is a TANK in human form I call him “Kratos” Sudhir is an army trained fitness expert who is an ace in weight training & cross fitness. He also trains me in kick boxing. Sudhir is extremely polite, humble & vigilant. He is capable of identifying the individual endurance limit better than the individual himself. Sudhir gave me results in 30 days. I highly- highly recommend him.

Manav Patil (@manavpatilofficial) is a certified trainer & a nutrition expert. Manav is quite active on Instagram & has a legion of followers. Like Sudhir, Manav also has a packed schedule it would be difficult to get these two as your P.T. Manav’s expertise is more on weight training & nutritioning. BTW, he makes really good Instagram reels.

Amit Jadhav (@jadhav_1693) & Suraj Gaikwad (@surajvamangaikwad) are other two tall well-built dudes, They are both experts in weight training & are extremely polite & approachable. Apart from them, there are other trainers like Amit, Pratik, Manish and many more who have their own strengths.

To summarize, this is an excellent one stop solution to take care of your physique. You have to give in your time, dedication & consistency, Earth Fitness will take care of the rest. Results are guaranteed.

featured_reviews.name: suraj upadhyay
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star Review – Earth Fitness, Vasai West

Very disappointing experience. This gym keeps changing rules frequently, mainly for cost-cutting, and it seriously affects members.

There is no general trainer available on the floor. Every trainer is focused only on selling personal training. If you don’t take PT, you are left completely on your own. This is unsafe, especially for beginners. In case of any injury, only the personal trainer is held responsible—there is no general supervision at all, which is unacceptable for a professional gym.

They also keep reducing facilities to save costs, like:

Steam access is restricted with unnecessary prior booking

Limited days and time slots for steam use which is reducing day by day I think it will be closed as it is complimentary when asked for steam as if they are doing favour to clients after taking there package 3 days to not even 1.5 days fully left

Rules keep changing without proper communication to members

All these changes feel less about discipline and more about cutting expenses while charging full fees.

A gym should prioritize member safety, guidance, and basic facilities, not just push personal training packages. Definitely not worth the money not even personal training.
